missionFit.rule: Every full article must have a substantive, source-supported operating implication involving AI, automation, data/decisioning, cybersecurity or fraud technology, digital banking/payments technology, or technology governance. Preserve broad functional coverage through those lenses. General credit-union regulation, macroeconomics, personnel, legal, finance, market or governance developments do not qualify by themselves when the technology/AI connection is only incidental or an internal-link aside.
examplesInScope: payments, identity, cybersecurity and data technology
AI workforce, vendor and compliance implementation

productionBehavior: Candidates that pass hard stops and score at or above the minimum publish directly to main. Failed candidates are logged with reasons and do not request routine human approval.

cycleOwnership.articleCycle: Owns one full News or Insights article only. It must not publish Alerts or remain open solely because the daily Alert target is unfilled.
cycleOwnership.alertCycle: Owns Alerts separately. The daily Alert target remains three and is tracked in daily-cycle-state.json.

standardCycle.completionRule: For the article cycle, do not end after the first rejected or duplicate candidate. Continue through the ranked pool until one full article publishes, or every qualified article candidate in the expanded search has been exhausted. The separate Alert cycle owns the three-alert daily target; an Alert shortfall must not block or extend article-cycle completion.
standardCycle.shortfallRule: Never weaken evidence, mission-fit or quality gates to fill a slot. When the article target remains unfilled, record the candidates evaluated, rejection reason for each, beats and sources searched, and the exact evidence gap. Alert shortfalls are recorded and handled only by the separate Alert cycle.
